results.title: Akhilesh Yadav vs BJP: Akhilesh Yadav Targets BJP, Says Public Will Never Forgive Broken Promises
results.description: Samajwadi Party president and Lok Sabha MP Akhilesh Yadav launched a sharp attack on the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), claiming that the public will never forgive the ruling party for failing to fulfil its promises. In a post on X, Akhilesh said that even if the BJP offered a "dandavat" (prostration) apology, people would not forgive it because it had failed to honour its commitments to the electorate. He further alleged that the BJP's arrogance would ultimately lead to the downfall of its government. Responding to recent remarks by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Akhilesh also said that those raising questions should not be dismissed as "misguided," adding that they are fellow travellers on the path of democracy rather than people who have lost their way. His comments come amid continuing political exchanges between the Opposition and the ruling party over governance, public welfare, and accountability. The statement has intensified the ongoing war of words between the Samajwadi Party and the BJP ahead of key political developments.

results.title: Picking Atiku as VP was biggest mistake of my presidency —Obasanjo
results.description: Former President Olusegun Obasanjo says he regrets his decision to pick former Vice President Atiku Abubakar as his running mate in the 1999 presidential election, describing it as the biggest mistake of his presidency.
